alignment.basis: Rigidly reframe along the mapped long southern monastic facade, from the western tower/library end toward the eastern junction. Clock tower and projecting western library distinguish signed facing; no rescale of any geographic control.

selectionRule: Preserve six unioned current controls for core only; mapped tower is a part of the basilica. Rigidly rotate all controls without rescaling. Current core union has two holes; retain earlier main-only geometry separately. Roof-mask coordinates rounded to0.01mm for clipping.
